newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA - LANDSBERGIS SAYS WILL RUN FOR PRESIDENT.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA - LANDSBERGIS SAYS WILL RUN FOR PRESIDENT.

text.p: Lithuanian parliamentary chairman Vytautas Landsbergis said on Saturday that he will run in December's presidential race.
"I will stand as a candidate in the next presidential election," Landsbergis told Reuters ahead of a Conservative party conference.
The conference is expected to name Landsbergis as its candidate for the race.

Landsbergis' Conervative Party was swept to victory in last October's parliamentary elections but his arch-foe, President Algirdas Brazasukas, continues to top opinion polls as the best man for the job.
